headlines.title: FDA orders new warning on GLP-1s over rare eye condition linked to sudden blindness
headlines.description: GLP-1 drugs may increase the risk of NAION, a rare optic nerve condition that can lead to sudden vision loss. It has no known treatment.

headlines.title: The ‘slam dunk’ that wasn’t: Promising cholesterol drug fails to prevent heart attacks or stroke
headlines.description: An experimental drug that held great promise in driving down a dangerous form of cholesterol didn’t show any measurable impact on heart attack or stroke in a clinical trial.

headlines.title: Muscle health is key to longevity. Here’s how to measure yours.
headlines.description: Body mechanics experts say muscle health is linked to our longevity and how well we fight off disease.

headlines.title: Multiple California half-marathon runners hospitalized with ‘unusual symptoms’
headlines.description: An investigation is underway after at least 25 runners sought medical treatment for “unusual symptoms" after running a half marathon in Santa Barbara, California. Santa Barbara News-Press reporter Angel Corzo spoke with NBC News’ Yasmin Vossoughian about the police investigation.

headlines.title: FDA orders warning on popular GLP-1 weight loss drugs
headlines.description: There’s a new alert on those popular GLP-1 weight loss drugs. The FDA is now mandating a warning label that the drugs may cause sudden blindness. NBC News’ Stephanie Gosk reports.

headlines.title: How Parents Can Give Themselves Grace During the Holidays
headlines.description: Sissy Goff and David Thomas, licensed professional counselors and New York Times bestselling authors of “Capable: How to Teach Your Kids the Strengths, Skills and Strategies to Build Reslience,” join TODAY to discuss ways that moms and dads can give themselves grace and enjoy the overwhelming holiday season.

headlines.title: NBC's Chloe Melas Opens Up About Journey With IBD
headlines.description: NBC’s Chloe Melas joins TODAY to share her new book “The Girl’s Guide to Guts: Everything Your Doc Didn’t Tell You But Your Bestie Would,” opening up about her journey with ulcerative colitis. NBC’s medical contributor Dr. Natalie Azar also breaks down the biggest misconceptions of inflammatory bowel disease.

headlines.title: 21 thoughtful gifts for hosts that will get you an invite to the next party
headlines.description: If you’re headed to a holiday party, be sure to show up with one of these fun gifts for hosts to show your appreciation.

headlines.title: Glycerin vs. hyaluronic acid: Which ingredient is best for winter?
headlines.description: Glycerin and hyaluronic acid are both common ingredients in your favorite hydrating skin care — I asked a dermatologist to find out which works better for dry skin.
